enabled.description: Enable the shared external identity contract used by Trino and the optional UI integrations.

accessRoles.description: Keycloak-centered catalog of platform roles and app access.

global.description: Cross-cutting settings shared across the umbrella chart, including storage and catalog definitions.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in generated Kubernetes resource names.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the fully qualified release name used in generated Kubernetes resource names.

domain.description: Base domain used by components that generate hostnames, such as optional Hive ingress resources.

environment.description: Short environment label used to distinguish local, development, or production-style deployments.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secret references shared across components that honor the global value.

identity.description: Runtime copy of the shared identity contract consumed by subcharts.

authorization.description: Runtime copy of the shared authorization contract consumed by subcharts.

storage.description: Object-store configuration shared by locally owned composition logic and downstream components.

backend.description: Select whether the deployment uses an external S3-compatible object store or the in-cluster MinIO dependency.

s3.description: Connection and credential settings for the S3-compatible object-store endpoint.

endpoint.description: S3-compatible endpoint URL, for example the MinIO service or an external object-store endpoint.

region.description: Logical region for the configured object store.

pathStyleAccess.description: Enable path-style S3 access, which is commonly required for MinIO and some S3-compatible endpoints.

accessKey.description: Inline access key used by example overlays or simple local deployments.

secretKey.description: Inline secret key used by example overlays or simple local deployments.

existingSecret.description: Existing Kubernetes Secret name containing object-store credentials for chart renders that read secrets from the cluster.

accessKeyKey.description: Secret key name to read the access key from when external secret delivery is used.

secretKeyKey.description: Secret key name to read the secret key from when external secret delivery is used.

dataCatalogs.description: Catalog definitions that drive generated Trino catalogs, ACLs, and per-catalog Hive metastore resources.

type.description: Logical catalog type used by the local Trino and Hive composition logic.

authorizedRoles.description: Catalog-level role access lists used by generated Trino access rules and Ranger catalog ACL import.

warehouseDir.description: This catalog's own complete warehouse location (e.g. s3a://bucket/warehouse/catalog-name), passed to its Hive metastore instance and used as-is. Required on every catalog -- there is no shared fallback, so catalogs needing separate buckets and catalogs sharing one both say so explicitly. Must be unique across catalogs.

trino.description: Pass-through values for the vendored Trino chart plus the top-level enablement flag.

keycloak.description: Pass-through values for the bundled Keycloak dependency used when identity.provider.mode is bundledKeycloak.

platformHome.description: Lightweight static launchpad that becomes the default browser entrypoint in shared environments.

sharedPostgresql.description: Optional shared PostgreSQL dependency plus chart-owned provisioning for app databases and users.

databases.description: New map-based shared PostgreSQL contract for application-specific database provisioning; legacy list entries should move to provisioning.database-list.

hiveMetastore.description: When enabled, provisions one database per global.dataCatalogs entry on the shared PostgreSQL instance, owned by hive.externalDatabase.user/existingSecret (read directly -- no credentials are duplicated here). Requires hive.externalDatabase.host to point at the shared PostgreSQL service.

database-list.description: Legacy list-based shared PostgreSQL contract kept for non-Prefect integrations during migration.

jupyterhub.description: Pass-through values for the optional JupyterHub dependency plus the top-level enablement flag.

cloudbeaver.description: Real subchart at charts/dlh-in-a-box/charts/cloudbeaver/ -- see its own values.schema.json for the authoritative, strict shape. This stub only documents the one key the umbrella level itself reads (Chart.yaml's dependency condition).

rangerPostgresql.description: Pass-through values for the Ranger PostgreSQL dependency.

prefect.description: Feature toggles for the Prefect server and worker subcomponents.

enabled.description: Create Kubernetes primitives for Prefect flow-run Job pods.

prefectServer.description: Direct pass-through values for the upstream Prefect Server chart.

prefectWorker.description: Direct pass-through values for the upstream Prefect Worker chart.

prefect-auth-proxy.description: Pass-through values for the oauth2-proxy dependency that can protect Prefect in shared environments.

cloudbeaver-auth-proxy.description: Pass-through values for the oauth2-proxy dependency that protects CloudBeaver.

sparkOperator.description: Pass-through values for the Spark Operator dependency.

minio.description: Pass-through values for the MinIO dependency used in local and self-contained deployments.

datahub.description: Pass-through values for the optional DataHub dependency.

datahubPrerequisites.description: Pass-through values for the DataHub prerequisites chart deployed alongside DataHub.

superset.description: Pass-through values for the optional Apache Superset dependency plus the top-level enablement flag.

hive.description: Settings for the locally owned Hive metastore subchart.

metastore.description: Container image settings for the Hive metastore runtime.

schemainit.description: Container image and optional hook-job settings for Hive schema initialization.

postgresql.description: Bundled PostgreSQL dependency owned by this chart (Hive's own dev-grade instance). enabled=true also makes Hive self-create its per-catalog databases, since it connects as that instance's superuser.

externalDatabase.description: Connection details for a PostgreSQL instance this chart doesn't own -- a genuinely external cluster, or a shared instance -- used whenever postgresql.enabled=false.

s3.description: S3 connectivity used by Hive metastore instances when reading and writing warehouse data.

warehouseDir.description: Complete warehouse location for this chart's own default single metastore.

database.description: Database name for this chart's own default single metastore, used whenever nothing calls hive.metastoreInstance with an explicit name.

ingress.description: Optional ingress settings for exposing Hive metastore services.

vault.description: Pass-through values for the Vault dependency.
